0022600086.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Milwaukee Bucks on the road at the Washington Wizards. Nate Ament is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision for Milwaukee, while Washington will be without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), all listed as out. The Bucks lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 109-99 defeat in Washington on January 29, 2026.
